## What does this plugin do? / 这个插件做什么？

<!-- One or two sentences a non-developer can understand. / 一两句普通人能看懂的话。 -->

## Name and version / 名称和版本

## Where it came from, what changed / 来源与改动

## Capabilities, permissions, network, dependencies / 能力、权限、联网、依赖

## How it was tested, known limits / 怎么测的，已知限制

- [ ] Validated, packed, installed, used, and uninstalled / 已验证、打包、安装、实际使用并卸载
- [ ] ZIP and index match; no credentials or private data / ZIP 与 index 对应，不含凭据或隐私数据
